title: Metatranscriptomic profiling of aerobic granular sludge under plastic particle and copper stress
description: This project investigates the metatranscriptomic responses of aerobic granular sludge microbial communities to copper ions alone and in combination with polystyrene microplastics or nanoplastics. The dataset includes a control sample and three exposure conditions and is intended to characterize changes in microbial gene expression and functional pathways under different environmental stress conditions.
